candidates.title: AdaCGen: Heterogeneity-Aware Layer Management for Efficient KV Cache Offloading in LLMs
candidates.reason: Layer-wise attention-sparsity heterogeneity is used to co-optimize KV-cache offload transfer and compute, directly extending CPU/GPU hierarchical-memory, KV offloading, and prefetch lineages.

candidates.title: From Rigid to Dynamic: Entropy-Guided Adaptive Inference for Long-Context LLMs
candidates.reason: EntropyInfer adaptively allocates attention compute per head/segment and compresses decode KV state, with reported long-context end-to-end speedups; it directly updates sparse-attention and KV-compression system lineages.

candidates.title: The Price of Anarchy in Disaggregated Inference
candidates.reason: The work studies prefill/decode resource partitioning, hierarchical KV-cache externalities, and adaptive routing on NVIDIA Dynamo, directly relevant to disaggregated serving and KV-aware scheduling.

candidates.title: ArborKV: Structure-Aware KV Cache Management for Scaling Tree-based LLM Reasoning
candidates.reason: ArborKV couples tree-aware allocation, token-extractive eviction, and lazy rehydration to reduce KV memory for branching reasoning workloads, directly extending KV-cache management for agentic/reasoning serving.

candidates.title: LPC: Efficient Lossless Parameter Compression for Deploying LLM Inference on Edge Systems
candidates.reason: LPC targets host-to-accelerator weight-transfer bandwidth with lossless runtime compression and measured offloading speedups, directly matching parameter offload and hierarchical-memory inference.
